steps.why_en: Menu exists but has no send option, only templates and exclusions.
steps.why_id: Menu ada tapi tidak ada pilihan kirim, hanya template dan exclusion.

steps.en: Officer picks email or SMS as the sending mode
steps.id: Officer memilih mode kirim email atau SMS
steps.why_en: The compose pages were removed; no screen offers this choice.
steps.why_id: Halaman compose sudah dihapus; tidak ada layar yang menawarkan pilihan ini.

steps.en: Officer chooses to send a single or multiple messages
steps.id: Officer memilih kirim satu atau banyak pesan
steps.why_en: No single or multiple choice exists on any screen.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pilihan satu atau banyak di layar mana pun.

steps.en: A single row of recipient, subject and message is shown
steps.id: Satu baris penerima, subject, dan pesan ditampilkan
steps.why_en: No send screen exists; the template form has no recipient field.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar kirim; form template tidak punya kolom penerima.

steps.en: Many rows of recipients, subjects and messages are shown
steps.id: Banyak baris penerima, subject, dan pesan ditampilkan
steps.why_en: No multi-row screen exists on the current code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar banyak baris di code saat ini.
